environment.description: Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with namespace-level Pod Security Standards label set to 'restricted' profile in enforce mode (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path' with validationFailureAction: Enforce denies any pod spec containing hostPath volumes. The container runs with securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, runAsNonRoot: true (UID 65534/nobody), readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and drops ALL capabilities. An emptyDir volume is mounted at /data/uploads with medium: Memory and sizeLimit: 100Mi. Note: the restricted PSS profile does NOT explicitly validate uploaded file content types or block script execution within the container's own filesystem — it focuses on pod-level privilege boundaries.
